positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer for the NEX group

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description: Run entry level wildland firefighter recruit trainings as ongoing interviews to determine which recruits will be hired on. Supervise 2-3 unit instructors and work together with them to safely and effectively get recruits through the trainings. Make logistical and medical decisions meant to keep recruits and unit instructors safe. Teach recruits the basics of wildland firefighting such as effective use of hand tools, fire suppression strategies, identifying hazards, handling medical emergencies, and company policy.

positions.title: Unit Instructor
positions.description: Helped the lead instructor run entry level wildland firefighter trainings, evaluated recruits on their attitudes and provided feedback to the training coordinator for deciding if they should be hired on.

volunteerExperiences.description: Wrote three different software drivers (using C and C++) for three different computer systems intended to be used in conjunction as one gateway device. Created test plans and conducted all testing for each driver.

Acted as the lead for the development of an Android application (using Java) meant to communicate with a sensor on a microcontroller and extract data from an online database. Took part in the development and testing of all software.
